name: MANTEDANIB 100 Capsule 10's
introduction:
Introduction About MANTEDANIB 100 CAPSULE

MANTEDANIB 100 CAPSULE contains Nintedanib which belongs to the group of medicines called Kinase inhibitors. It is used to manage idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF), chronic fibrosing interstitial lung diseases (ILDs) with a progressive phenotype, slowing the rate of decline in pulmonary function in patients with systemic sclerosis-associated interstitial lung disease (SSc-ILD). It is used in combination with docetaxel in adult patients for the management of locally advanced metastatic or recurrent non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) of adenocarcinoma tumor histology after first line chemotherapy.

Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (IPF) is a chronic lung disorder in which the lungs become scarred and breathing becomes increasingly difficult. Symptoms include shortness of breath, persistent dry cough, tiredness, loss of appetite, weight loss, rounded and swollen fingertips (clubbed fingers).

Before taking MANTEDANIB 100 CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have liver, heart or bleeding problems, history of blood clots or had a recent surgery in stomach. MANTEDANIB 100 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by your doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk. Before starting management with MANTEDANIB 100 CAPSULE, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition. 

MANTEDANIB 100 CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). The most common side effects of taking MANTEDANIB 100 CAPSULE are diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, loss of appetite, headache, weight loss and high blood pressure. Consult your doctor if any of the symptom worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How MANTEDANIB 100 CAPSULE Works

MANTEDANIB 100 CAPSULE is a tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI) which works by blocking the enzymes in cells of the lungs called tyrosine kinases. Blocking these enzymes helps to decrease fibrous tissue formation in the lungs, thereby stops the symptoms of lung disease getting worse.
usageDetails:
How to use MANTEDANIB 100 CAPSULE

Take MANTEDANIB 100 CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush, chew, or open the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you based upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking MANTEDANIB 100 CAPSULE unless your doctor advises you to stop.

name: Capnea Oral Solution 1ml
introduction:
Introduction About CAPNEA SOLUTION

CAPNEA SOLUTION contains Caffeine which belongs to the group of medicines called CNS stimulants. It is used to manage primary apnea (episodes of interrupted breathing) in premature babies. Primary apnea in premature babies happens due to immature development of baby’s breathing centers.

CAPNEA SOLUTION has been shown to reduce the number of episodes of interrupted breathing in premature newborns babies. It can also be used to manage bronchopulmonary dysplasia (airway damage) among premature babies.

Before CAPNEA SOLUTION is administered, inform your doctor if you child has any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if your child suffers from seizure disorders, slow weight gain or frequent regurgitation (spitting up of milk or food) as a precaution.

If you are the mother of the premature infant who receives the management, you must not drink coffee or take foods which has high caffeine content. This is because the caffeine taken by the breastfeeding mother may pass through the breast milk to the nursing premature infant who is already receiving caffeine therapy and may lead to an overdosage. The most common side effect of CAPNEA SOLUTION is fast or irregular heart rate. Consult your doctor if it worsens.
uses: Manage primary apnea (episodes of interrupted breathing) in premature babies
Manage and manages bronchopulmonary dysplasia (airway damage) in premature babies
usesDetails:
Uses Of CAPNEA SOLUTION
Manage primary apnea (episodes of interrupted breathing) in premature babies
Manage and manages bronchopulmonary dysplasia (airway damage) in premature babies
mechanismOfAction:
How CAPNEA SOLUTION Works

CAPNEA SOLUTION is a CNS stimulant. It works by stimulating a part of the brain that controls breathing. As a result, the brain transfers a lot of breathing signals to the lungs which makes the lungs breathe more deeper and faster. It also increases the number of breathing cycles, manages the airway damage and reduces the need for mechanical ventilation.
usageDetails:
How to use CAPNEA SOLUTION

CAPNEA SOLUTION will be administered orally (via gastric feeding tube) to your child only by a doctor or a nurse.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for your child based on their gestational age, body weight and health condition.

Introduction About CAFIRATE ORAL 20MG SOLUTION

CAFIRATE ORAL 20MG SOLUTION contains Caffeine which belongs to the group of medicines called CNS stimulants. It is used to manage primary apnea (episodes of interrupted breathing) in premature babies. Primary apnea in premature babies happens due to immature development of baby’s breathing centers.

CAFIRATE ORAL 20MG SOLUTION has been shown to reduce the number of episodes of interrupted breathing in premature newborns babies. It can also be used to manage bronchopulmonary dysplasia (airway damage) among premature babies.

Before CAFIRATE ORAL 20MG SOLUTION is administered, inform your doctor if you child has any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if your child suffers from seizure disorders, slow weight gain or frequent regurgitation (spitting up of milk or food) as a precaution.

If you are the mother of the premature infant who receives the management, you must not drink coffee or take foods which has high caffeine content. This is because the caffeine taken by the breastfeeding mother may pass through the breast milk to the nursing premature infant who is already receiving caffeine therapy and may lead to an overdosage. The most common side effect of CAFIRATE ORAL 20MG SOLUTION is fast or irregular heart rate. Consult your doctor if it worsens.

Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (IPF) is a chronic lung disorder in which the lungs become scarred and breathing becomes increasingly difficult. Symptoms include shortness of breath, persistent dry cough, tiredness, loss of appetite, weight loss, rounded and swollen fingertips (clubbed fingers).

Before taking IDOFNIB 100 SOFT GELATIN CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have liver, heart or bleeding problems, history of blood clots or had a recent surgery in stomach. IDOFNIB 100 SOFT GELATIN CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by your doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk. Before starting management with IDOFNIB 100 SOFT GELATIN CAPSULE, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition. 

IDOFNIB 100 SOFT GELATIN CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). The most common side effects of taking IDOFNIB 100 SOFT GELATIN CAPSULE are diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, loss of appetite, headache, weight loss and high blood pressure. Consult your doctor if any of the symptom worsens.

Introduction About FIBNIB 100 CAPSULE

FIBNIB 100 CAPSULE contains Nintedanib which belongs to the group of medicines called Kinase inhibitors. It is used to manage idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF), chronic fibrosing interstitial lung diseases (ILDs) with a progressive phenotype, slowing the rate of decline in pulmonary function in patients with systemic sclerosis-associated interstitial lung disease (SSc-ILD). It is used in combination with docetaxel in adult patients for the management of locally advanced metastatic or recurrent non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) of adenocarcinoma tumor histology after first line chemotherapy.

Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (IPF) is a chronic lung disorder in which the lungs become scarred and breathing becomes increasingly difficult. Symptoms include shortness of breath, persistent dry cough, tiredness, loss of appetite, weight loss, rounded and swollen fingertips (clubbed fingers).

Before taking FIBNIB 100 CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have liver, heart or bleeding problems, history of blood clots or had a recent surgery in stomach. FIBNIB 100 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by your doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk. Before starting management with FIBNIB 100 CAPSULE, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition. 

FIBNIB 100 CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). The most common side effects of taking FIBNIB 100 CAPSULE are diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, loss of appetite, headache, weight loss and high blood pressure. Consult your doctor if any of the symptom worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About FIBRODONE 200MG TABLET

Fibrodone 200 mg Tablet is a key component in management plans for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF), a progressive lung condition marked by scarring and stiffening of lung tissue. It contains pirfenidone, an established antifibrotic agent that targets pathways driving fibrosis, inflammation, and oxidative damage in the lungs. This positions it as an essential therapy for slowing disease progression in adults with IPF, always under specialist oversight.

Fibrodone helps manage IPF by reducing fibroblast proliferation, limiting collagen buildup, and easing lung inflammation. It's prescribed for confirmed IPF cases to preserve lung function and quality of life. Take it precisely as directed, typically with food to avoid gastrointestinal upset. Swallow whole with water, ideally at consistent times daily. Never adjust dosage or discontinue without consulting your doctor. Routine lung function tests and monitoring are standard during therapy.

Key precautions involve sun protection due to photosensitivity risks, and disclosing all medications or conditions to your doctor. Avoid use in pregnancy; breastfeeding requires medical advice. Common side effects include nausea, dizziness, fatigue, diarrhoea, weight loss, and sunlight sensitivity. Contact your doctor for persistent or severe effects, like breathing worsening or skin reactions.

Introduction About CAFIRATE ORAL 20MG SOLUTION

CAFIRATE ORAL 20MG SOLUTION contains Caffeine which belongs to the group of medicines called CNS stimulants. It is used to manage primary apnea (episodes of interrupted breathing) in premature babies. Primary apnea in premature babies happens due to immature development of baby’s breathing centers.

CAFIRATE ORAL 20MG SOLUTION has been shown to reduce the number of episodes of interrupted breathing in premature newborns babies. It can also be used to manage bronchopulmonary dysplasia (airway damage) among premature babies.

Before CAFIRATE ORAL 20MG SOLUTION is administered, inform your doctor if you child has any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if your child suffers from seizure disorders, slow weight gain or frequent regurgitation (spitting up of milk or food) as a precaution.

If you are the mother of the premature infant who receives the management, you must not drink coffee or take foods which has high caffeine content. This is because the caffeine taken by the breastfeeding mother may pass through the breast milk to the nursing premature infant who is already receiving caffeine therapy and may lead to an overdosage. The most common side effect of CAFIRATE ORAL 20MG SOLUTION is fast or irregular heart rate. Consult your doctor if it worsens.

Introduction About MACDANIB 100MG SOFT GELATIN CAPSULE

MACDANIB 100MG SOFT GELATIN CAPSULE contains Nintedanib which belongs to the group of medicines called Kinase inhibitors. It is used to manage idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF), chronic fibrosing interstitial lung diseases (ILDs) with a progressive phenotype, slowing the rate of decline in pulmonary function in patients with systemic sclerosis-associated interstitial lung disease (SSc-ILD). It is used in combination with docetaxel in adult patients for the management of locally advanced metastatic or recurrent non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) of adenocarcinoma tumor histology after first line chemotherapy.

Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (IPF) is a chronic lung disorder in which the lungs become scarred and breathing becomes increasingly difficult. Symptoms include shortness of breath, persistent dry cough, tiredness, loss of appetite, weight loss, rounded and swollen fingertips (clubbed fingers).

Before taking MACDANIB 100MG SOFT GELATIN CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have liver, heart or bleeding problems, history of blood clots or had a recent surgery in stomach. MACDANIB 100MG SOFT GELATIN CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by your doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk. Before starting management with MACDANIB 100MG SOFT GELATIN CAPSULE, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition. 

MACDANIB 100MG SOFT GELATIN CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). The most common side effects of taking MACDANIB 100MG SOFT GELATIN CAPSULE are diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, loss of appetite, headache, weight loss and high blood pressure. Consult your doctor if any of the symptom worsens.

How MACDANIB 100MG SOFT GELATIN CAPSULE Works

MACDANIB 100MG SOFT GELATIN CAPSULE is a tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI) which works by blocking the enzymes in cells of the lungs called tyrosine kinases. Blocking these enzymes helps to decrease fibrous tissue formation in the lungs, thereby stops the symptoms of lung disease getting worse.

Take MACDANIB 100MG SOFT GELATIN CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush, chew, or open the medicine.
